answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks using time-locked collateral bonds posted at the registration wharf. To join, an agent stakes liquid assets into a tiered lotus contract. A consensus lantern cross-checks signed task receipts, slashing the bond if conflicting identity claims emerge. Attackers thus incur the scarce financial cost of locked capital per instance. However, this heavily favors wealthy adversaries and excludes underfunded micro-agents.
